declarations.name: ChompLean.rowstart_source_iff_colTail_or_host_before
declarations.typePretty:
∀ (M : ChompLean.RecurrenceModel) {q c z s b : Nat} (hsz : @LT.lt.{0} Nat instLTNat s z)
  (hstart : @Eq.{1} Nat (ChompLean.RecurrenceModel.f M z s) z) (hcq : @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat c q)
  (hbq : @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat b q) (hhost : @Eq.{1} Nat (ChompLean.RecurrenceModel.f M q b) z),
  Iff (ChompLean.B (ChompLean.RecurrenceModel.f M) q c z)

declarations.name: ChompLean.rowstart_source_hole_iff_no_colTail_and_host_not_left

  (hstart : @Eq.{1} Nat (ChompLean.RecurrenceModel.f M z s) z) (hcq : @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat c q)
  (hbq : @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat b q) (hhost : @Eq.{1} Nat (ChompLean.RecurrenceModel.f M q b) z),

declarations.name: ChompLean.vertical_hole_birth_iff_prefix_eviction
declarations.typePretty:
∀ {f : Nat → Nat → Nat} {r c z : Nat} (hcr : @LE.le.{0} Nat instLENat c r),
  Iff
    (And (ChompLean.B f r c z)
      (Not
        (ChompLean.B f
          (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat) r
            (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))))
          c z)))
    (And (ChompLean.C f r c z)
      (And (Not (ChompLean.R f r c z))
        (And (@Ne.{1} Nat (f r c) z)
          (Not
            (ChompLean.C f
              (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd.{0} Nat instAddNat) r
                (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))))
              c z)))))
